2025 Filmfare OTT Awards The 6th edition of the Filmfare OTT Awards 2025 celebrated outstanding artistic and technical achievements in Hindi-language original content produced for streaming platforms. Web series and films released on OTT services between 1 August 2024 and 31 July 2025 qualified for consideration. Filmfare officially revealed the nominations on 5 December 2025.
IC 814: The Kandahar Hijack and Khauf led 14  nomination and Black Warrant won Best Drama Series.
Winners and nominees
*Nominations were announced on 9th December 2025.
*Winners were announced on 15th December 2025.
*Winners denoted in boldface
